settings.heading: Like what you saw on Shark Tank? Want to be part of it?

settings.text:
AirTulip is redefining sleep with airflow technology used by elite athletes—but it’s built for everyone. Now we’re exploring ways to let YOU become part of our journey.

We’re considering opening a public investment round where everyday supporters—not just big VCs—can own a piece of what we’re building. Whether you’re thinking $100 or more, this is your chance to help shape the future of clean, healthy sleep.

This isn’t a formal offer—just a way to gauge interest and keep you in the loop if we move forward.

Tell us your interest and drop your email below

settings.heading: Tell Us You're Interested
settings.description:
Legal Disclaimer
This is not an offer to sell or a solicitation of an offer to buy any securities. Indications of interest are non-binding. No money or other consideration is being solicited, and if sent, will not be accepted. No offer to buy the securities can be accepted and no part of the purchase price can be received until an offering statement filed with the Securities and Exchange Commission has been qualified. Any indication of interest involves no obligation or commitment of any kind.

settings.heading: Institutional or Accredited Angel Investor?
settings.description:
AirTulip is already backed by angels and VCs who believe in our mission: redefining sleep and recovery through laminar airflow technology.

We’re now exploring additional partnerships with accredited investors and institutional backers for our next phase of growth. If you're interested in a direct conversation about our traction, roadmap, and investment terms—leave your details below and we’ll get in touch.
